At decision 277 (lines 809–811), substring-based crypt recognition incorrectly excluded that exposed heap from ordinary pickup routes. Source-pinned offline reconstruction matched all 277 preceding selected actions and reasons; an isolated candidate probe then selected the item pickup without dispatch. The proposed correction narrowly distinguishes the corroborated item heap from unopened remains and retains hazard checks and honest collection receipts. Independently, mandatory potion discovery remained blocked by missing haste for the recognized sentry room. Its geometry was complete, but no reachable bank satisfied the current distance-five staging envelope; geometry-revelation fallbacks therefore offered no progress. The pickup correction does not establish a sentry solution or successful descent.
